    Scalar centering of Boca coefficients #

    A chosen coordinate defines the reference state on each copy of ℂ^m. These lemmas split every coefficient into its centered and scalar parts and expose the corresponding first-step expansion of a word evaluation.

        theorem ZFib.External.OperatorAlgebra.CEP.Faithful.evalWord_cons_centeredAt {X : Type} {m : ℕ} {B : Type u} [CStarAlgebra B] [PartialOrder B] [StarOrderedRing B] (iota : X → (Fin m → ℂ) →⋆ₐ[ℂ] B) (i0 : Fin m) (x : X) (a : Fin m → ℂ) (word : CEP.BocaReducedWord X m) :
        CEP.evalWord iota ((x, a) :: word) = (iota x) (bocaCenteredAt i0 a) * CEP.evalWord iota word + a i0 • CEP.evalWord iota word
